func _init() -> void:
	var World = load("res://ecs/world.gd")
	var w = World.new()

	# create / alive / index / generation
	var e1 := w.create_entity()
	assert(w.is_alive(e1))
	var s1 := w.get_index(e1)
	var g1 := w.get_generation(e1)
	assert(s1 >= 0 and s1 < 65536)
	var e2 := w.create_entity()
	assert(w.is_alive(e2))
	assert(w.get_index(e2) != s1)

	# component methods
	assert(w.has_component(e1, &"Pos") == false)
	assert(w.add_component(e1, &"Pos", {"x": 1.0, "y": 2.0}))
	assert(w.has_component(e1, &"Pos"))
	var d := w.get_component(e1, &"Pos")
	assert(d.x == 1.0 and d.y == 2.0)
	assert(w.get_component_types(e1) == [&"Pos"])

	# multiple components
	assert(w.add_component(e1, &"Vel", {"vx": 3.0}))
	assert(w.has_component(e1, &"Pos") and w.has_component(e1, &"Vel"))
	var types := w.get_component_types(e1)
	assert(types == [&"Pos", &"Vel"] or types == [&"Vel", &"Pos"])
	assert(types.size() == 2)
	# sorted order check
	var sorted_types = Array(types).duplicate()
	sorted_types.sort()
	assert(types == sorted_types)

	# remove
	assert(w.remove_component(e1, &"Pos"))
	assert(w.has_component(e1, &"Vel"))
	assert(not w.has_component(e1, &"Pos"))
	assert(w.get_component_types(e1) == [&"Vel"])
	assert(w.get_component(e1, &"Pos") == null)

	# stale handle rejects
	var e3 := w.create_entity()
	var s3 := w.get_index(e3)
	assert(w.destroy_entity(e3))
	assert(not w.is_alive(e3))
	assert(w.add_component(e3, &"A", {}) == false)
	assert(w.get_component(e3, &"A") == null)
	assert(w.has_component(e3, &"A") == false)
	assert(w.get_component_types(e3) == null)
	# destroy again -> false
	assert(w.destroy_entity(e3) == false)

	# recycling: same slot gets new generation
	var e4 := w.create_entity()
	var s4 := w.get_index(e4)
	# We know free_slots is a stack and slot 0 was consumed last? Actually after
	# creating e1,e2 and destroying e3 (slot?) — to be safe let's just create
	# until recycling happens.
	pass

	# Recycling guarantee: when exactly one slot is free, next create reuses it
	# and gets a different generation.
	var w2 = World.new()
	var all := []
	# exhaust all but one slot
	all.append(w2.create_entity())
	# ... actually there are 65536 slots, too many to exhaust. Let's just create
	# and destroy and check generation increment.
	var ea := w2.create_entity()
	var ga := w2.get_generation(ea)
	assert(w2.destroy_entity(ea))
	var eb := w2.create_entity()
	assert(w2.get_index(eb) == w2.get_index(ea))
	assert(w2.get_generation(eb) != ga)
	assert(w2.is_alive(eb))
	assert(not w2.is_alive(ea))
	# old handle rejects live entity
	assert(w2.get_component(ea, &"Pos") == null)
	assert(w2.has_component(ea, &"Pos") == false)
	assert(w2.destroy_entity(ea) == false)
	assert(w2.add_component(ea, &"Pos", {}) == false)
	assert(w2.remove_component(ea, &"Pos") == false)

	# query

	var qa := q.create_entity()
	var qb := q.create_entity()
	var qc := q.create_entity()
	q.add_component(qa, &"A", {}); q.add_component(qa, &"B", {})
	q.add_component(qb, &"A", {})
	q.add_component(qc, &"B", {})
	# superset

	assert(r1.size() == 2)
	assert(r1.has(qa) and r1.has(qb))
	var r2 := q.query([&"B"])
	assert(r2.size() == 2)
	assert(r2.has(qa) and r2.has(qc))
	var r3 := q.query([&"A", &"B"])
	assert(r3.size() == 1)
	assert(r3[0] == qa)
	var r4 := q.query([])
